record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Psalm<WH04210> <FI>or<Fi> Song<WH07892> for the sons<WH01121> of Korah<WH07141>.<Fo><Fo> His foundation<WH03248> <FI>is<Fi> in the holy<WH06944> mountains<WH02042>. <RF>for the sons: or, of the sons<Rf>

As well the singers<WH07891><WTH8802> as the players<WH02490><WTH8802> on instruments <FI>shall be there<Fi> : all my springs<WH04599> <FI>are<Fi> in thee.<CM>
